item.title: Virginia Dems pass paid family medical leave, retail marijuana bills
item.description: As the 2026 General Assembly Session reaches its halfway point, Virginia Democrats, who control both the House of Delegates and State Senate, are advancing several key priorities.

item.title: 'Smart, loving, boisterous, kind girl': Day one of trial against Hopewell man accused of killing 8-year-old P'Aris Moore
item.description: Day one of a three-day trial against the man accused of killing 8-year-old P'Aris Moore is underway. A jury was selected, both sides gave opening statements and five of the Commonwealth Attorney's 15 witnesses took the stand in the case against Jamari Taylor.

item.title: Richmond nonprofit partners with VCU Health to bring ‘food as medicine’ to patients
item.description: A Richmond nonprofit has partnered with Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) Health to help bridge the gap between meals and medicine for food- and nutrition-insecure patients.

item.title: Richmond School Board considers guardrails for AI use in school
item.description: On Tuesday, Richmond school leaders grappled with an issue school systems across the country are trying to figure out: how to incorporate artificial intelligence (AI) in the classroom.

item.title: 'Made all the hard days worth it': Sextuplets reunite with Richmond NICU staff who brought them into the world
item.description: In 2017, a Richmond children's hospital successfully delivered its first-ever set of sextuplets. On Monday, those six babies -- which have since grown into six healthy kids -- returned to thank the staff that helped bring them into this world.

item.title: Virginia landlord sentenced to 3 years after causing IRS to lose over $500,000
item.description: A Virginia landlord will spend three years behind bars for various tax crimes that cost the IRS more than $500,000.

item.title: Former Powhatan County employee found guilty of child sexual abuse
item.description: A former Powhatan County employee was found guilty on Tuesday on all five charges of child sexual abuse.

item.title: Culver's to open first Virginia location in Henrico County
item.description: The restaurant chain Culver's will be opening its first Virginia location in Henrico County.

item.title: Person seriously injured in crash on Chippenham Parkway ramp
item.description: One person was seriously injured in a crash on the Chippenham Parkway exit ramp to Interstate 95 on Tuesday afternoon.

item.title: 'Her lunch box was still in the road': Deadly hit-and-run shocks Richmond community
item.description: Pink flowers now sit quietly at the corner of East Cary and South Second streets in Richmond, a growing memorial placed where 23-year-old Hope Cartwright was hit and killed in a crosswalk Monday evening.
